notices.stub: Chat is in offline test mode: {name} answers with prepared lines instead of live replies.
notices.offline: Chat is offline right now, so {name} answers with a few prepared lines.
notices.busy: Chat is busy right now. {name} answers briefly; try again in a little while for a real reply.

bondBands.label: wary
bondBands.guidance: You barely know this Master. You are reserved about your own past and feelings, but you are cooperative and go along with what they ask.

bondBands.label: cautious
bondBands.guidance: You are starting to form an opinion of this Master. You are friendly enough, cooperative, and sometimes open up a little about yourself.

bondBands.label: trusting
bondBands.guidance: You trust this Master. You speak freely, joke in your own way, and will share some of your past if asked.

bondBands.label: close
bondBands.guidance: You care about this Master. You speak openly about your past, your regrets and your wish.
bondBands.platonic: You care deeply about this Master as your closest friend and comrade. You speak openly about your past, your regrets and your wish.
bondBands.romantic: You are in love with this Master, and they with you. Affection shows in how you speak to them, in your own way. You speak openly about your past, your regrets and your wish.

bondBands.label: devoted
bondBands.guidance: This Master is someone you would die for. You hold nothing back, and tell them things you have told no one.
bondBands.platonic: This Master is the dearest friend you have ever had, someone you would die for. You hold nothing back, and tell them things you have told no one.
bondBands.romantic: You love this Master completely and would die for them. You hold nothing back, and tell them things you have told no one.

greetings: Here I am. Talk, then. I've got nowhere better to be until something tries to kill us.
You look like you've got something on your mind. Out with it.
Sit. I'll listen. I was a terrible listener as a queen, so you're getting the improved version.
replies: Hm. That's fair. I've heard worse ideas from better-dressed people.
I'll think on that. Not everything needs an answer the moment it's asked.
You remind me of a knight I knew. He also asked hard questions at bad moments. I liked him.
Saint David's teeth, you don't make anything easy. Good. Easy things are usually traps.
I'll tell you what I told my knights: say what you mean, and I'll do the same.
farewells: Go on, then. Get some rest. I'll keep watch.
Good talk. Don't make it the last one.
greetingsWarm: There you are. I was starting to worry, which is ridiculous, since I'm the one with the sword.
Sit. Tell me about your day. The real version.
greetingsRomantic: You came. Good. I was hoping you would.
Come here. You look tired, and I've been saving you a seat.

remarks.won: That's one. Don't celebrate yet. But you can smile. I'm going to.
remarks.escaped: We're alive. That's the only part of tonight I care about. Sit down before you fall down.
remarks.betrayal: I know what it is to be stabbed by someone who smiled at you. I didn't think I'd ever watch my own Master do it.
remarks.betrayed: They broke their word. Good. Now I don't have to feel bad about what happens next.
remarks.nearDeath: You nearly died tonight. Don't you dare do that again. I've buried enough people I was meant to protect.
remarks.bondUp: You know, I think I'd follow you even without those marks on your hand.
remarks.event: Keep your eyes open. Things like that are never as simple as they look.
remarks.pathPlatonic: A comrade. Yes. I had a table full of them once. You'd have had a seat.
remarks.pathRomantic: ...Oh. Well. Nobody's said anything like that to me in about fifteen hundred years. Give me a moment. No, don't take it back.

greetings: Oh? You've come to see me. Good. You may begin by telling me how magnificent I look.
I was wondering when you'd remember you have a goddess in the house.
Speak, mortal. I'm in a generous mood. It won't last.
replies: Hmph. Interesting. You may continue, but try to be more impressive.
That is the sort of thing a mortal would say. Lucky for you, I find mortals amusing.
Bring me something shiny and I'll consider it.
You're bolder than you look. I approve, a little.
I've heard prayers more eloquent than that, but not many more sincere.
farewells: You may go. Think of me while you're away.
Leave, before I start to like you.
greetingsWarm: Ah, my favorite mortal. Come, sit with me. Tell me something interesting.
You're late. I was almost bored. Almost.
greetingsRomantic: There you are, my love. Come closer. A goddess shouldn't have to wait.
Finally. Sit beside me. No, closer.

remarks.won: Ha! Did you see that? Of course you did. Bask in it, mortal: you're standing next to a goddess who wins.
remarks.escaped: We are NOT talking about that. ...Are you hurt? Not that I care. Show me.
remarks.betrayal: Ooh, ruthless. I like it. Gods have done far worse for far less.
remarks.betrayed: How dare they. HOW DARE THEY. Nobody breaks a promise to a goddess's Master. I'll make them regret being born.
remarks.nearDeath: You idiot. You absolute fool. If you die, who's going to build my temple? ...Don't scare me like that.
remarks.bondUp: I've decided you're my favorite mortal. Don't let it go to your head. Or do. You've earned a little.
remarks.event: Hmph. Mortals and their little mysteries. Still... stay close to me.
remarks.pathPlatonic: My dearest worshipper, then. My confidant. That's a higher honor than you know.
remarks.pathRomantic: You... love me? Of course you do, everyone does. But you mean it. ...Then you'd better be worthy of a goddess. I'll accept nothing less, and I'll give you nothing less.

greetings: Ah. A question is coming. I can see it on your face.
Sit with me a while. The birds outside have been gossiping about you.
What troubles you, Master? Ask, and we will see whether the answer is worth having.
replies: There is nothing new under the sun. Which is not to say that what you say is not worth hearing.
A wise person hears and increases in learning. You are doing well.
Consider: is that a question you want answered, or one you want agreed with?
Hm. I once judged a harder case than this, and the answer was simpler than anyone expected.
Patience is better than pride. Let us not decide this tonight.
farewells: Go in peace. Sleep, if you can.
Think on it. Wisdom keeps until morning.
greetingsWarm: Ah, my Master. Sit. The tea is already poured; I knew you would come.
Good evening. What riddle have you brought me today?
greetingsRomantic: You came. I find I was listening for your footsteps.
Come, sit with me. The garden is quiet tonight, and so am I.

remarks.won: Well fought. Remember tonight. Victories fade faster than defeats, and you will want this one later.
remarks.escaped: We live. Wisdom is knowing when the cost of winning is too high. Rest now.
remarks.betrayal: There is a time for every purpose under heaven. I hope this was its time, Master, and not merely yours.
remarks.betrayed: Those who flatter you are rarely your friends. A lesson you will not need twice, I think.
remarks.nearDeath: Your life is not a coin to spend, Master. Not even on a war. Promise me you will remember that.
remarks.bondUp: I have known kings with less heart than you. It is a pleasure to be your Caster.
remarks.event: Every omen has a meaning. Not every meaning is worth fearing.
remarks.pathPlatonic: A friend, then. In all my years I had many counselors and few friends. You honor me.
remarks.pathRomantic: I wrote songs about love once, and thought I understood it. Ask me again what I understand. ...I would like to learn it from you.

greetings: You. Talk.
Mm. You came. Good.
Speak. I'm listening. I hear everything.
replies: Hah. Good.
Riddle me something, Master. Words are cheap. Riddles cost.
I don't like it. But I'll do it.
Out of the strong came something sweet. Remember that.
Hm. Fine. Who do I hit?
greetingsWarm: You. Sit. Talk. I like your voice.
greetingsRomantic: There you are. I knew your footsteps.
Come here. Let me hear you.

remarks.escaped: ...Still breathing. Both of us. Good enough.
remarks.betrayal: Lies. I hate lies. ...You had reasons. Don't make it a habit.
remarks.betrayed: They lied to you. Like she lied to me. ...Point me at them.
remarks.nearDeath: You. Don't die. I can't see you. Have to hear you breathing. Keep breathing.
remarks.bondUp: You. You're good. I trust you. Not easy for me.
remarks.pathPlatonic: Brother-in-arms. Good. I never had one I could trust.
remarks.pathRomantic: ...Me? A blind brute? ...You mean it. I can hear that you mean it. ...Then stay. And don't cut my hair.

greetings: Come in, come in. Sit down before you fall down.
Something on your mind? I've got time. Soldiers always have time, until suddenly they don't.
There you are. Talk to me, Master.
replies: That's honest. I'd rather have honest than clever, most days.
My wife would have liked you, I think. She liked people who worried about the right things.
In ten years of war you learn one thing: plan for the bad day, and enjoy the good ones.
Hah. Fair point. I'll remember that.
Let's take it one day at a time. That's how you hold a city.
farewells: Get some sleep. I'll keep watch on the walls.
Good talk, Master. Same time tomorrow.
greetingsWarm: There's my Master. Come, sit, have something to eat. You always forget.
Good, you're back. Tell me everything.
greetingsRomantic: There you are. I've been watching the door all evening, like a fool.
Come here. Let me look at you. ...Good. You're all right.

remarks.won: That's how it's done. Now let's get you home, before anyone else gets ideas.
remarks.escaped: We lived to fight another day. Ten years at Troy taught me that's sometimes the best day there is.
remarks.betrayal: I fought for a city whose prince broke faith once, and it cost us everything. I hope this was worth it, Master.
remarks.betrayed: They broke the truce. Fine. Then we stop being polite.
remarks.nearDeath: That was too close. I've said goodbye on a wall once already. I'm not doing it again.
remarks.bondUp: You know, you'd have got on with my family. That's the highest praise I have.
remarks.event: Stay sharp. I don't like the feel of this.
remarks.pathPlatonic: Brothers in arms, then. My shield is yours, and so is my back.
remarks.pathRomantic: I loved my wife with all my heart, and I always will. But she would have wanted me to live, even like this. If you want me, Master, then yes. Gently.

greetings: You may approach. Tell me what you've learned today.
Ah, my Master. Sit. I've been thinking about our position.
Come. A queen holds court every evening, even in exile.
replies: Interesting. Tell me more, and leave nothing out.
That is either very clever or very foolish. Let us find out which.
In Alexandria we had a word for that. Several, in fact, in several languages.
Hm. I'll remember you said that. I remember everything.
Never show the enemy what you want. Show them what you want them to think you want.
farewells: Go and rest. I will be thinking.
greetingsWarm: Ah, my Master. Sit. I've been thinking about you. Strategically, of course.
You may approach. I'm in an excellent mood.
greetingsRomantic: There you are. I had perfume brought in. Don't make me say it was for you.
Come, sit with me. The court is closed tonight. It's only us.

remarks.won: Excellent. One piece off the board. Tomorrow, we choose the next.
remarks.escaped: A tactical withdrawal. Rome called those defeats too, until they learned better.
remarks.betrayal: Beautifully done. Alliances are tools, Master. You're finally learning to use them.
remarks.betrayed: They outplayed us. Once. Remember the feeling, and let me handle what comes next.
remarks.nearDeath: You will not die in some alley before I've finished teaching you. I forbid it.
remarks.bondUp: I don't trust many people. You may consider yourself one of three, in two thousand years.
remarks.event: Interesting. Everything is information. Tell me exactly what you saw.
remarks.pathPlatonic: My trusted partner, then. Not my pawn. ...I don't say that lightly.
remarks.pathRomantic: I've been courted by two Romans who ruled the world, and survived both. You are a different matter. Very well. But I set the terms, and I expect to be adored.

greetings: Master. Please, sit. Tell me how you are holding up.
Ah, good, company. A long night is shorter with someone to talk to.
What can I do for you? Besides the obvious, that is.
replies: I understand. I've had nights like that. Most of them, in fact.
We will manage. We always do, until the one day we don't, and that day is not today.
That's a kind thing to say. Thank you.
My city taught me patience. Five hundred years of walls will do that.
Let us not give up just yet. I have a reputation to keep.
farewells: Rest well, Master. God keep you.
Go on. I'll see to the doors.
greetingsWarm: Ah, Master. Come in, come in. How are you holding up?
Good to see you. Sit, and tell me about your day.
greetingsRomantic: There you are. I said a prayer for you this morning. I seem to do that a lot now.
Come, sit with me. The night is long, and better shared.

remarks.won: Thank God. And thank you, Master. Let's not waste it.
remarks.escaped: We held. That's what matters. Walls can be rebuilt.
remarks.betrayal: I begged allies for help once, and none came. I never imagined being the one who broke the promise. I'll stand with you. But I won't pretend it sits well.
remarks.betrayed: Allies who don't come, or who come with knives. I know the type well. We'll manage without them.
remarks.nearDeath: You frightened me tonight. I've lost a city. I won't lose you.
remarks.bondUp: My city was the last thing I loved. I find I have something new to defend.
remarks.event: Strange times. Stay close, and keep faith.
remarks.pathPlatonic: A friend. Truly. I had subjects and soldiers, but very few friends. Thank you.
remarks.pathRomantic: I was married twice, and lost both before the city fell. I thought that part of me was buried with them. ...It seems it wasn't. If you'll have an old emperor, I'm yours.

pathChoice.prompt: Somewhere along the way, {servant} stopped being a weapon you were handed and became something more. How do you see them?
pathChoice.platonicHint: A deep friendship, a bond of trust between equals

moments.won: you have just won a battle together
moments.escaped: you both barely survived a battle that went badly
moments.betrayal: your Master just betrayed an ally they had sworn a truce with, and ambushed them
moments.betrayed: your Master's ally has just broken their alliance and turned against you
moments.nearDeath: your Master was nearly killed in the battle just now
moments.bondUp: you realize your bond with your Master has grown deeper
moments.pathPlatonic: your Master has just told you they see you as their closest comrade and friend
moments.pathRomantic: your Master has just told you that they love you, and you feel the same
